title: CCI imposes penalty on HP India and its certain resellers for indulging in anti-competitive practices in supply of Supplies products
CCI imposes penalty on HP India and its certain resellers for indulging in anti-competitive practices in supply of personal system products

CCI directs seventeen Opposite Parties to cease and desist from anticompetitive practices in relation to tenders invited by Assam Police Housing Corporation Limited for “Internal and External Electrification works in Police Station Buildings” across the State of Assam.
